newsitem.title: GERMANY: Delta drops one daily Frankfurt-NYK flight.
newsitem.headline: Delta drops one daily Frankfurt-NYK flight.

text.p: Delta Air Lines said it will drop one of its two daily passenger Frankfurt-New York flights from November 1.
But it will start a new Frankfurt-Cincinatti service on the same day, the U.S. carrier said.
Danita Waterfall, Delta's regional director cargo sales and services Europe, said the New York flight with a Tristar L-1011-500 will be withdrawn due to low passenger yields on the route.
The second daily Cincinatti service will be flown with a Boeing 767-300ER aircraft, she said.
A McDonnell Douglas MD-11 is used on the existing Cincinatti flight.
The two daily Atlanta flights will be upgraded with MD-11 aircraft on both services instead of one flight with a Tristar L-1011-500, she said.
Waterfall said Delta aims to use the additional Cincinatti flight to sell more cargo to the West Coast transiting through the hub.
New York and Atlanta are the main two U.S. destinations for Delta cargo out of Europe, she added. --Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 8982 Fax +44 171 542 5017
